text: Представьте: утро в Праге. За окном старинные крыши, впереди четыре дня путешествия, а заботы остались дома. Новый год в Праге, с 31 декабря по 3 января. Перелет, гостиница и завтраки. Стоимость от 899 евро на человека.
delivery_prompt_en: A natural, mature male Russian narrator for a cinematic, intimate travel story. Warm, deep but not forced, calm and trustworthy. Begin softly and invitingly, build a gentle sense of discovery, articulate dates and price clearly. Subtle emotional variation. No shouting, announcer tone, dramatic bass, or exaggerated advertising enthusiasm. Read the Russian text exactly as written.

gemini.speech_prompt: Warm, intimate Russian travel storytelling, mature and trustworthy male voice, natural phrasing, soft start, slight wonder, precise date and price delivery.

google_chirp_3_hd.note: Keep raw text for baseline; do not pass unsupported SSML or speaking-rate settings unless verified in active API version.

elevenlabs.selection: Choose and verify native Russian male narrator in voice library; record actual voice_id prior to synthesis.
elevenlabs.model: check current permitted multilingual model before test

minimax.note: Preview voice choice in Russian; no paid synthesis until quota approved.

a2e.note: IDs and rates returned from authenticated read-only voice_list. This file does not trigger generation.

safety.run_status: Gemini Orus verified; further male-only Gemini samples planned, A2E excluded per user

character_voice_brief.role: Simba — recurring adult male brand character, not a generic travel-announcement narrator
character_voice_brief.perceived_age: mature middle-aged adult male; exact age not yet specified
character_voice_brief.delivery: Russian-speaking, natural conversational baritone or low-mid register; warm and confident, expressive but restrained; relaxed and recognizable across videos
character_voice_brief.desired: presence, warmth, friendly authority, gentle rasp optional, consistent character
character_voice_brief.avoid: young-boy tone, over-deep growl, theatrical announcer, theatrical lion imitation, robotic precision, shouting
character_voice_brief.selection_process: Judge same script and at least one informational passage. Rate distinctiveness and consistency between repeated generations; keep a fixed voice ID and a reusable delivery style.

selection_shortlist.note: Google catalog descriptions are not age classifications; actual Russian audio must be auditioned.

persistent_voice_id_storage.note: Resolve persistent voice_id from the existing private Drive metadata at runtime. Do not recreate the voice for each clip or commit its ID into the public repository.

production_voice.approved_for: Simba character voice in Russian video narration
production_voice.delivery_style: mature warm baritone, natural conversational Russian, subtle huskiness, confident calm and wry humor; no announcer hype
